messages:
Alex R: Hey team — I'm scheduled to shadow on-call this weekend (Sat/Sun). Wanted to coordinate primary/secondary slots, runbook walkthroughs, and a quick paging test beforehand. cc @Lina M @Sam T :wave:

oncall-bot: Reminder: Weekly on-call shadow cohort starting this Friday. Add yourself to the shift in the rotation if not already assigned: https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotation :bell:

Lina M: I can take primary for Sat 09:00-17:00 (PST). I have the primary phone and will be available for any pages. :thumbsup:

Sam T: I can cover Sat 17:00-23:59 and overnight Sun 00:00-08:00 if needed. Nights are quieter but I'll be ready. Also can be secondary for the Sat daytime slot.

Priya K: Happy to do a quick runbook walkthrough Fri 16:00 PST (30m). I can share the core links and a checklist for new shadows. Will post the runbook link and a short checklist after this thread. :calendar:

Diego S: Heads up — there's a coverage gap Sun 02:00-05:00 where no one is assigned in the current rotation. I'm on call that weekend but have a personal appointment Sun 03:00-04:30. If we can swap a 2-3h block I'm free to pick up earlier or later.

Alex R: Thanks — can someone propose an explicit swap to fill Diego's gap? I can probably cover Sun 02:00-03:30 if Sam pushes his overnight to start at 03:30 instead.

Sam T: I can shift so I start at 03:30 and take through 08:00 if that works. So new Sat/Sun plan: Lina primary Sat 09-17, Sam primary Sat 17 - Sun 08:00 (with split start at 03:30), Diego picks up Sun daytime. Priya will be on-call escalation only.

Priya K: OK locking that in. For the runbook walkthrough — basics to cover: how to triage a prod latency page, how to check model-serving pool health, how to re-route traffic to fallback model, and how to escalate to SRE. I'll paste snippets and links now. :pushpin:

Priya K: Runbook links:
- Triage checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/triage-checklist
- Model serving playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving
- Escalation matrix: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escalation-matrix

Priya K: Quick checklist for shadows (copy into your notes):
1) Ensure phone escalation is set (Settings -> Notifications).
2) Run a paging test: see command below.
3) Open the triage checklist and follow step 1 (is request backlog increasing?).
4) If latency > SLO 2x, follow model-serving rollback steps.
5) If unclear customer impact, ask Support to pull recent customer traces.

Priya K: Paging test (run before your shift):
```
# test pager to your phone and slack
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/oncall/test-page \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"user":"alexr","method":"sms"}'
```
Please confirm you actually receive the SMS and a slack DM from oncall-bot.

Alex R: Running test now...

oncall-bot: Test page delivered to Alex R via slack DM and SMS (delivery: 2.3s) :white_check_mark:

Alex R: Got both — SMS and DM. Good to go.

Lina M: Quick note on runbook step specifics: if you see the model-serving pool at 90% utilization and latency rising, prefer cache-priming + small scale-up before full rollback. See section "gradual degradation" in the model-serving playbook.

Diego S: Regarding the Sun 02-05 gap — confirmed Sam can shift and I'll take Sun 08:00 onward. Thanks Sam for swapping. I'll update my calendar.

Sam T: Done, calendar updated and I added a short handover message on the rotation page with the swap details.

Priya K: A few on-call tips for new shadows: keep messages short and timestamped, escalate with a summary block, and avoid re-running heavy evals during incident triage. Example escalate template:
```
SEV: P2 (latency spike)
What: generation latency > 2x SLO impacting 8% of requests
When: 2024-09-14T09:12Z
Triage done: looked at backlog, redis hit rate, model pool health
Next steps: scale pool + clear cache prefix, monitoring links below
Escalate to: Priya K, oncall-sre
```

incident-bot: Notice: Yesterday's brief edge cache disruption was mitigated by automatic rollback. No customer-facing impact recorded. Incident ref: INC-2024-9876.

Alex R: Great — can we confirm who is the emergency escalation after on-call for each shift (pager → Slack → phone)? Lina, Sam, Diego, Priya please confirm preferred escalation order.

Lina M: Pager -> Slack DM -> Phone call to me -> then Priya -> Oncall SRE pager.

Sam T: Same for me. Phone is the fastest after Slack DM.

Diego S: Pager -> Phone -> Ping Priya. I'll also set my emergency contact in the rotation page.

Priya K: I'll be the on-call escalation for Saturdays; for Sundays escalate to engineering leads if I don't ack in 10 minutes.

Alex R: Awesome. Final checklist before shadowing:
- Run pager test (done)
- Attend Fri 16:00 runbook walkthrough (Priya)
- Calendar invites updated (Sam + Diego swapped)
- Handover doc link: https://redwood.internal/oncall/handovers/week-2024-09-14

Alex R: Thanks everyone. I'll join the Fri walkthrough and post a short handover note at the start of my shadow shift with contact info and escalation preferences. :thumbsup:

Lina M: See you Friday. Welcome to on-call, Alex! :tada:
